sections.label: Left paws and haunch
sections.evidence: White bricks at x=6–11, z=4–9 form a front paw; orange clusters behind it at z=10–19 build the haunch, with an orange leg rising to y=5.

sections.label: Right paws and haunch
sections.evidence: White bricks at x=13–18 form the other front paw. Rear orange clusters build its haunch and the tail curve, while central orange spans connect the lower torso.

sections.label: Torso and haunches
sections.evidence: Orange courses fill the broad rear body at z=10–19 and rise along both flanks, connecting the haunches through the central torso.

sections.label: Chest and shoulders
sections.evidence: White #176, #207, #237, #240 and #270–273 form the front chest patch. Orange courses surround it and narrow upward toward the shoulders at y=10–12.

sections.label: Muzzle and cheeks
sections.evidence: White bricks project forward at z=1–5, y=11–13, while orange courses widen around them into cheeks spanning approximately x=5–19.

sections.label: Eyes and face
sections.evidence: Black pairs #425–426 and #448, #450 form eyes at x=8–10 and x=14–16, y=14–15. Orange face courses surround the eyes and centered white muzzle.

sections.label: Forehead and ears
sections.evidence: Orange courses at y=16–17 shape the forehead and paired ears. Tan interiors #493–494, #499 and #502 lead to narrow orange tips #519–520 at y=19.

sections.label: Raised tail
sections.evidence: Orange bricks form a narrow upright at x=20–23, z=6–11, y=2–7. Tan #244, #275–277, #281 and #304 form its contrasting tip.

sections.label: Forehead stripe and ear edges
sections.evidence: Brown #474 and #491 form a centered forehead stripe at y=16–17. Orange #513 and #516 add matching edges to the two ears at y=18.

sections.label: White paw contours
sections.evidence: Six small white assemblies extend the front, outer and rear edges of the paired paw footprints at y=0–1, spanning z=3–10.

sections.label: Muzzle tip
sections.evidence: White #366 and #393 stack at x=10–14, z=1–2, y=12–13, forming the foremost edge of the centered muzzle.
